sections.title: Residential Movers in Eagle Rock, CA
sections.content: Eagle Rock backs up against the San Rafael Hills between Glendale and Pasadena, and its homes run from Craftsman bungalows and Spanish Revival houses on tree-lined streets to hillside view homes and condos along Colorado and Eagle Rock boulevards. If you are comparing affordable, reliable movers in Eagle Rock, start with the paperwork and the price. SOS Moving at a glance: Licensed and covered: CPUC licensed (CAL-T0192140), registered as USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871, with full liability coverage and workers' compensation. Monday–Thursday and Friday–Sunday rates: From $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate, $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee. Reviewed in public: 4.9 on Google across 1,007 reviews. Questions about your street, your stairs or your date? Call 909-443-0004, open Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, or ask for a free estimate.

sections.title: Movers and Packers in Eagle Rock
sections.content: Eagle Rock's Craftsman houses, many of them around Hill Drive and on the northern slopes, often have built-in bookcases and buffets whose contents all need boxes. Our packing services cover the whole house or only the rooms you would rather not touch. How the packing gets done: Whole house or partial: Full packing, or just the kitchen, closets and fragile pieces while you box the rest. Built-ins emptied shelf by shelf: Books, dishes and glassware come off built-in shelves and go into boxes marked with the room they belong in. Wrapped for the trip: Blankets and shrink wrap on furniture, wardrobe boxes for hanging clothes, and white glove handling for art and antiques. Ask for packing when you request your free estimate, and we can finish the boxes before the truck is loaded.

sections.title: Eagle Rock Local Movers
sections.content: Unless the destination calls for our long-distance movers, moves around Northeast LA or next door to Glendale, Pasadena, Highland Park and Glassell Park are priced by the hour. That covers a family leaving a Craftsman near Hill Drive as much as an Occidental senior moving a bed and a desk into a first off-campus apartment. Monday–Thursday run from $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck at the cash rate and Friday–Sunday $135/hr, plus a $30 gas fee and a $50 deposit that goes toward your total. Included in the hourly rate: Hills and stairs: Eagle Rock's hillside streets can be steep and winding; stairs, long carries and multiple stops are part of the hourly rate, not add-ons. Supplies on the truck: Blankets, shrink wrap, tape and wardrobe boxes come with the move. Setup at the new address: Furniture disassembly and reassembly, TV unmounting, placement in the right rooms and help with unpacking. Street parking near Colorado Boulevard is competitive, so tell us about your driveway or curb space when you book. Under CPUC rules, longer local moves carry Double Drive Time; long-distance moves are priced on their own.

sections.title: Eagle Rock Long-Distance Movers
sections.content: Eagle Rock is framed by two freeways: the Glendale Freeway (SR-2) on its western edge, which meets I-5, and the Ventura Freeway (SR-134) on its northern edge, running past the namesake rock and on to I-210 in Pasadena. For a move from Eagle Rock, CA to another part of the state or another state, we plan the packing, the loading and the delivery with you before the truck leaves. Before the truck leaves Eagle Rock: Registered carrier: USDOT 3398018 and MC 1153871 for interstate moves, and CPUC licensed (CAL-T0192140) for moves within California. Packed before the drive: Our packers can box and wrap the house before loading, including furniture that has to come apart. Storage if dates don't match: Closing date slipped or the lease starts later? Storage holds your belongings until the new place is ready. Staying closer than a long-distance move? Our local moving service is billed by the hour.

sections.title: Commercial Movers in Eagle Rock
sections.content: Moving a shop, studio or office on or near Colorado Boulevard? Our commercial movers handle desks, files, fixtures and equipment, with weekend dates for businesses that can't close on a weekday.

faq.question: Do stairs or steep hillside streets cost extra in Eagle Rock?
faq.answer: No. Stairs, long carries and multiple stops are included in the hourly rate, which matters on Eagle Rock's steep, winding hillside streets. The item charges to know about are $200 for a piano and $150 for anything heavier than 300 lbs, plus the $30 gas fee.

faq.question: Do you move Occidental College students into off-campus apartments?
faq.answer: Yes. Occidental requires students to live in college housing through junior year, with limited exceptions, and seniors may live off campus. When that first lease in Eagle Rock or Highland Park starts, our apartment movers work at the same hourly rate, and storage can hold furniture between leases.

faq.question: What does a move from Eagle Rock to Glendale or Pasadena cost?
faq.answer: It is billed by the hour: from $119/hr for 2 movers and a truck Monday–Thursday at the cash rate and $135/hr Friday–Sunday, plus a $30 gas fee. A $50 deposit is applied toward your total. The final cost depends on how long the job takes, so a free estimate is the quickest way to a real number.

faq.question: Can you pack a Craftsman house with built-in cabinets?
faq.answer: Yes. Built-in bookcases and buffets stay with the house, but everything on their shelves has to be packed, and our packers can do that along with the rest of the house or just the fragile rooms. For art and antiques, ask about white glove handling.

faq.question: Can I book a same-day move in Eagle Rock?
faq.answer: Same-day moves depend on whether a crew is free that day, so call 909-443-0004 (Monday – Sunday, 8AM – 6PM) to find out. There is no Eagle Rock office; every move is booked through our Los Angeles headquarters at 5530 Jillson Street, Los Angeles, CA 90040.
